specification_evidence.specification_text: sed position for blocking the fluid- flow path 21 is shown in FIG. 3. The second dome 16 forms within the body of the shunt a second chamber 26. The first and second chambers are interconnected through a fluid passageway or conduit 24. Within the second chamber 26 is a valve seat 28 and a resilient diaphragm valve 30 seated in the valve seat. The valve seat is supported by the interior structure of the body of the shunt. The diaphragm valve can be selected so as to maintain a predetermined shunt pressure within the shunt. That is, the diaphragm valve 30 can be selected so that it opens to permit fluid flow only when a preselected fluid pressure is achieved in the second chamber 26. Preferably, the diaphragm valve is a one-way valve. Also within the body of the shunt is a third chamber 32. The third chamber 32 is formed between the base 13 of the shunt and the interior wall 27 forming the bottom wall of the second chamber. model_analyses.claim_passage: a pressure regulated valve means positioned within the first fluid-flow passageway for providing fluid flow therethrough at selected fluid pressures
model_analyses.analysis_text: C04-L5 recites 'a pressure-responsive valve mechanism in the primary drainage channel.' US4741730A claim 1 recites 'a pressure regulated valve means positioned within the first fluid-flow passageway for providing fluid flow therethrough at selected fluid pressures.' The specification discloses the corresponding structure: 'a resilient diaphragm valve 30 seated in the valve seat' that 'opens to permit fluid flow only when a preselected fluid pressure is achieved in the second chamber.' Under 35 USC 112(f), 'valve means...for providing fluid flow at selected fluid pressures' covers this diaphragm valve structure. C04-L5's 'pressure-responsive valve mechanism' is the same structure — a valve that responds to pressure. The specification confirms the corresponding structure. This limitation IS anticipated under 35 USC 102(a).
